hunks.sol: Maybe that was why the atmosphere in the room felt so unsettled.

hunks.sol: “I’m Jin Taekyung, the newly appointed leader of this White Tiger Hall reconnaissance squad. I look forward to working with you.”

hunks.baseline: Someone’s lonely applause died out within a few seconds, and Han Yeop lowered his hand with an embarrassed expression.
hunks.sol: The lonely applause died after only a few seconds. Han Yeop lowered his hands, looking embarrassed.

hunks.baseline: The atmosphere was stiffer than I had expected.
hunks.sol: The atmosphere was even stiffer than I’d expected.

hunks.baseline: *But that isn’t necessarily a bad thing.*
hunks.sol: *But that’s not necessarily a bad thing.*

hunks.baseline: We were in wartime. Maintaining the current tension was better than laughing together and trying to socialize.
hunks.sol: We were at war. It was better for them to stay tense than to laugh and socialize like we were all here to make friends.

hunks.baseline: Of course, too much tension could become poisonous. Easing it at the right moment was one of my duties as squad leader.
hunks.sol: Of course, too much tension could become poisonous. Easing it at the right time was also part of my job as squad leader.

hunks.baseline: Newbie Hunters froze the moment they entered a Gate for the first time. Real combat was different from practice. Everything they had learned and trained for at the Hunter training center flew off into outer space, and they were overwhelmed by the primal scent of death.
hunks.sol: Rookie Hunters froze the moment they entered a Gate for the first time. Real combat was nothing like practice. Everything they had learned at the Hunter training center went flying out the window, and the primal scent of death overwhelmed them.

hunks.baseline: That was why veterans in the Guild handled mental care for the rookies. I had been one of them.

hunks.sol: *Even if I only handled F-ranks.*

hunks.sol: The power levels were similar, too. From what I’d seen, a second-rate martial artist in Murim fell somewhere between an E-rank and an F-rank Hunter.

hunks.sol: In other words, I was now leading a ten-man F-rank party. I’d never actually been a party leader, but I’d watched other people do the job until I was sick of it.

hunks.baseline: “Raise your hand if you have combat experience.”
hunks.sol: “Anyone with combat experience, raise your hand.”

hunks.sol: At the abrupt question, every member of the reconnaissance squad raised a hand. They all looked confused.

hunks.baseline: “Raise your hand if you’ve been in combat at least five times.”
hunks.sol: “Keep it raised if you’ve fought at least five times.”

hunks.baseline: Half the hands went down. Han Yeop was among them.
hunks.sol: Half the hands went down. Han Yeop’s was among them.

hunks.sol: Five people with experience in at least five battles. That wasn’t bad. In fact, it was better than I’d expected.

hunks.baseline: “Raise your hand if you’ve killed someone.”
hunks.sol: “Keep it raised if you’ve killed someone.”

hunks.baseline: Four hands dropped weakly. I looked at the only member of the reconnaissance squad who still had his hand raised.
hunks.sol: Four hands slowly dropped. I looked at the only member of the reconnaissance squad whose hand remained raised.

hunks.baseline: “Five. It was during last year’s bandit suppression campaign. One of them was a Deputy Stronghold Lord. He was quite a strong bastard—”
hunks.sol: “Five. It was during last year’s bandit suppression campaign. One of them was a Deputy Stronghold Lord. He was a pretty strong bastard—”

hunks.baseline: I cut him off before he could continue.
hunks.sol: I cut him off.

hunks.sol: Hyuk Mujin’s mouth snapped shut.

hunks.baseline: “Yeah. Speak up now if you don’t like it.”
hunks.sol: “Yeah. If you don’t want the job, say so now.”

hunks.sol: I went around the room, assigning everyone a number from One to Ten.

hunks.sol: “Because it’s convenient. We might end up fighting today. Do you want to spend the whole day memorizing names?”

hunks.sol: Hyuk Mujin glared at me, his expression rigid, but I didn’t look away.

hunks.sol: Part of me even hoped he would act as insolent as he had the last time. We could end up in battle within a few days, and his current attitude would be a problem.

hunks.baseline: “……I will follow your orders.”
hunks.sol: “…I’ll follow your orders.”

hunks.baseline: “What did you say?”

hunks.baseline: “Number One. I said Number One.”
hunks.sol: “Number One. I said I’m Number One.”

hunks.baseline: Hyuk Mujin’s voice trembled as he answered. He was more perceptive than I had expected. Maybe it was because of the rumors about the Sleeping Dragon of Shanxi.

hunks.sol: *What kind of horrifying monoculture is this?*
